title: Queue retry workshop
content: Poison messages repeatedly fail processing. A dead-letter queue keeps failed messages available for inspection. Correct the payload and resubmit it; use idempotent receipts to handle duplicates.

title: Private DNS workshop
content: A private endpoint needs correct DNS resolution from the client network. Compare the resolved address with the intended private address before changing firewall rules.

title: Slow API workshop
content: Correlate a slow request with its dependencies and traces. Measure latency before and after a small controlled change. Small synthetic samples are not production performance benchmarks.

title: Sandbox identity workshop
content: This workshop uses temporary keys where managed identity is unavailable. Keep keys out of Git and evidence. A production extension should use least-privilege workload identities.

title: Cleanup workshop
content: Export sanitized evidence before the session expires. Inspect the Terraform destroy plan and remove only the resources owned by the experiment. Preserve the supplied resource group.
